description: Verification runs (--verify; docs/HARNESS.md, Correctness) of campaign w128-merge's nine configurations (the merge compaction and delta files at 128 MiB, docs/HYPOTHESES.md, registered 2026-11-20): every read checks each row it returns against the reference model. Nothing is measured: the laptop's runs measure, and these vouch for them request for request and byte for byte (steps_diff). Built from this commit, on the fork the laptop's runs used (atomicio 62cdc89288, core-perf cd7428b324). Longest jobs first; store_gib is each run's peak stored bytes with a margin.
